title: Pawn
beginning: Use the powers on the lowest rank green played card
end: Earn 5 gold
bonus: If you have this in play when another player wins the auction, you may take 1 of your exiled cards into your hand

title: Conspirator
beginning: Put 1 pawn from the bank on the left side of your deck
end: Draw the 2 rightmost cards in your deck

title: Thief
beginning: If the highest rank played card is red or yellow, earn 10 gold
end: Move the leftmost card in your deck to the right side

title: Guildmaster
beginning: Use the powers on the lowest rank yellow played card
end: Earn 1 silver
bonus: If you have this in play during the auction, you may bid silver

title: Princess
beginning: If the 2 lowest rank palace cards are the same color, earn the higher rank in coins
end: Swap the leftmost and rightmost cards in your deck

title: Radical
beginning: Draw 1 for each card in the dungeon
end: Put 1 pawn from the bank on trial

title: Diplomat
beginning: Take 1 of your exiled cards into your hand
end: If your deck is empty, earn 15 gold

title: Duellist
beginning: If anyone played a card ranked lower than 8, take 1 of your exiled cards back into your hand
end: Draw a number of cards equal to the least eyes on any green played card

title: Sheriff
beginning: If anyone other than you played a green card, take 3 pawns into your hand
end: Draw a number of cards equal to the most eyes on any played card

title: Warrior
beginning: Use the powers on the lowest rank non-red played card
end: Use the powers on the lowest rank non-red dungeon card
bonus: If you have this in play during the auction, your bid is increased by 10

title: Hostage
beginning: Put 1 pawn on the right side of your deck
end: Draw a number of cards equal to the lowest rank in the dungeon

title: Lawyer
beginning: Use the powers on the lowest rank non-red palace card
end: Use the powers on the highest rank green played card or highest rank green dungeon card, whichever is higher
bonus: If you have this in play when you win an auction, you may take cards from the dungeon as well as the trial

title: Pirate
beginning: Use the powers on the lowest rank yellow palace card
end: Use the powers on the highest rank yellow played card or highest rank yellow dungeon card, whichever is higher
bonus: If you have this in play when you win an auction, you may take any of the cards you win directly into your hand

title: Revolutionary
beginning: Use the powers on the rightmost non-red card in your deck
end: Use the powers on the highest rank non-red dungeon card
bonus: If you have this in play when you win an auction, you may take any number of cards from the dungeon into your hand

title: Heretic
beginning: Use the powers on the rightmost yellow card in your deck
end: Use the powers on the lowest rank palace card
bonus: If you have this in play when another player wins the auction, you may take any number of your exiled cards into your hand

title: Alchemist
beginning: Pay the rank of the rightmost card in your deck to the bank in coins
end: Earn 25 gold

title: Assassin
beginning: Earn 25 gold
end: Exile 1 card from your hand

title: Widow
beginning: If anyone played a card with 1 or more eyes, earn 15 gold
end: If your deck is empty, earn 15 gold

title: Icon
beginning: Earn 5 gold for each eye on the played cards
end: Earn the lowest rank on any yellow played card in coins

title: Pope
beginning: If anyone played a yellow card, earn 25 gold
end: Earn 5 gold for each of your exiled cards

title: Blackmailer
beginning: Earn 5 gold for each card in the dungeon
end: Earn the highest rank in the dungeon in coins

title: Smuggler
beginning: Earn twice the rank of the the biggest card in your deck
end: Move the biggest card in your deck to the left side

title: General
beginning: Earn the lowest green played rank in coins
end: Draw 5

title: Regent
beginning: If the rightmost card in your deck is green, draw 5
end: If the lowest or highest rank played card is green, draw 5

title: Saint
beginning: If you have 50 or less gold, draw 5
end: If you have 5 or less cards in your deck, draw them all
